data.text: We give thanks to you, God; we give thanks, for your name is near. People recount your wonderful deeds.
data.titulo: Thanksgiving to the God Who Judges Justly
data.subtitulo: For the music director. Do Not Destroy. A psalm of Asaph. A song.

data.text: “When I choose the appointed time, I will judge with equity.
data.titulo: The Judge Speaks at His Appointed Time

data.text: When the earth and all its inhabitants melt away, I am the one who has set its pillars firm. Selah.
I say to the boastful, ‘Do not boast,’ and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up your horn.
Do not lift your horn on high or speak with an arrogant neck.’”
For exaltation comes neither from the east nor from the west nor from the wilderness.
data.titulo: God Brings One Down and Lifts Another Up

data.text: It is God who judges: he brings one down and lifts another up.
For in the LORD’s hand is a cup, with foaming wine, full of mixed drink. He pours from it, and all the wicked of the earth will drain it, drinking even its dregs.
But I will declare it forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.
data.titulo: Praise and the Future of the Righteous

data.text: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous will be lifted up.
